name: muhsin
about: Hey there, I am Muhsin, studying Artificial Intelligence at Johannes Kepler University Linz. Most of my skills are self-taught, and I like to build end-to-end ML systems. I’m the kind of person who learns by building, so I pick projects that feel relevant or exciting. I’m not really a front-end guy, but I can handle minimal UI when it’s needed for ML.Outside of tech, I like being close to nature, spending time with cats, working out at the gym, thrifting.
